format_notice: Research display examples only; not an accepted native/product schema, source-admission object or parallel evidence authority. Existing owner mapping remains a later design gate.

records.subject: Dow / Performance Materials and Coatings
records.proposed_display: Sales improved while segment operating earnings declined.
records.measurement_scope: Q2 2026 versus Q2 2025; named segment, USD million.
records.interpretation: Reported revenue growth is not proof of a durable margin improvement.
records.next_evidence: Separate price, mix, volume, operating disruption and realized costs in subsequent reports.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not generalize one segment to all Dow businesses.

records.subject: Olin / chlor alkali and vinyls
records.proposed_display: A source-attributed outage offset improved underlying product economics.
records.measurement_scope: Quarterly segment earnings, including management estimate of outage cost/lost profit.
records.interpretation: A one-off adjustment can identify a research hypothesis without establishing a run-rate forecast.
records.next_evidence: Confirm physical recovery, lost-sales recapture and actual margin on the same product perimeter.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not count attributed lost profit and actual replacement sales twice.

records.subject: Linde / EMEA and capital measurement
records.proposed_display: Cost reimbursement and capital adjustments alter percentage interpretations.
records.measurement_scope: Q2 regional margin and separately company-wide trailing capital returns.
records.interpretation: Reported and adjusted metrics answer different questions; the two return ratios are not independent evidence.
records.next_evidence: Matched reporting basis for comparison, contract-specific volume/price terms and realized capital conversion.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not rank peers using unharmonized goodwill, numerator or averaging methods.

records.subject: Air Liquide / cash conversion and project capital
records.proposed_display: Ending receivables factoring changes cash timing; an investment backlog is not revenue.
records.measurement_scope: H1 2026 reported cash and year-end-to-half-year working capital; issuer-defined capex stock.
records.interpretation: The factoring addback is an isolated calculation, not a forecast that cash will recur.
records.next_evidence: Collection evidence, source-defined project startup, remaining capex and funded commitments.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not mix financing-class interest/lease cash with an incompatible FCF definition; no sum of backlog, opportunities and decisions.

records.subject: Sherwin-Williams / Paint Stores
records.proposed_display: A list-price announcement is not a realized all-company revenue increase.
records.measurement_scope: Q2 actuals and dated July annual-guidance revision; September effective-date announcement.
records.interpretation: Same-store sales and list pricing need independent volume/mix and realization evidence.
records.next_evidence: Achieved comparable price, customer retention, actual volume and subsequent raw-material costs.
records.forbidden_inference: The guidance midpoint change is company-to-company, not an analyst-consensus surprise.

records.subject: Eastman / diversified segments
records.proposed_display: Chemical Intermediates improvement coexists with weaker specialty-segment earnings.
records.measurement_scope: Q2 versus prior Q2 adjusted segment earnings; Q2 and H1 cash separate.
records.interpretation: A temporary spread benefit does not establish durable differentiated-product economics.
records.next_evidence: Persistence after supply normalization, same-business sales evidence and customer-specific commercialization.
records.forbidden_inference: Circular revenue growth without disclosed base, capital and margin does not prove a profitable ramp.

records.subject: Entegris / advanced materials and purity
records.proposed_display: Qualification can support repeat business while customer concentration limits pricing power.
records.measurement_scope: Company-reported 2025 business/risk description and Q2 2026 financial actuals.
records.interpretation: Distinguish consumed materials, process content and capital equipment; do not inherit an accepted supplier relationship from a theme label.
records.next_evidence: Customer/application-specific content, recurring purchases, support cost, qualification and margin evidence.
records.forbidden_inference: The numerical examples are issuer arithmetic, not a realized yield improvement or a validated moat score.

records.subject: Euro Chlor / measurement vintage
records.proposed_display: The same March 2025 output is paired with different published utilization vintages.
records.measurement_scope: Earlier and later publications for March 2025, not consecutive market observations.
records.interpretation: A later ratio is a revised observation; it is not a new independent production confirmation.
records.next_evidence: Original vintage and denominator explanation when available.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not infer a physical capacity closure or production improvement from the ratio change alone.
